scope: CPU text-query hybrid retrieval, filters, grouped evidence, citations and UI; Phase 7 release evaluation deferred

verification.frontend: Strict TypeScript and Vite production build passed
verification.model: Real pinned CPU EmbeddingGemma 2; deterministic API fixtures tested separately

exit_criteria.F1_F2_F7: Existing connector/ingestion/lifecycle tests remain passing; search exposes authorized processing counts and links to file status
exit_criteria.F3: Real native silent-video, non-speech audio, transcript and OCR filtered queries find expected retained fixtures
exit_criteria.F4: Dense exact cosine + PostgreSQL FTS + literal identifier candidates; common filters; evidence grouping; one vote per group/branch; RRF and asset diversity
exit_criteria.F5_F6: Every returned match/context citation resolves to its immutable revision; every top result has a valid document/media viewer descriptor; browser checks include loaded native audio/video and original document/image evidence
exit_criteria.F8: Runtime-role source/workspace isolation, guessed IDs, facets, context, tombstones and revocation during inference/ranking tested; no shared query cache
exit_criteria.F9: HTTP trace request ID, generation/profile pin, configuration SHA, filters and branch provenance persisted in response; generation cutover during inference tested
exit_criteria.nontext_retention: No text reranker; native-only audio/video/image results remain valid without OCR/transcription/captions
exit_criteria.experiment: Unified versus per-modality dense candidate budgets available with same 150-candidate total ceiling; actual fixed queries checked in both modes
exit_criteria.abstention: Versioned 0.70 dense floor calibrated on four positive and six negative local development queries; all six development negatives abstain in hybrid search

adopted_changes.dense_backend: Exact cosine for this small CPU corpus; HNSW preserved, filtered ANN activation/scale evaluation deferred
adopted_changes.cpu_busy: Immediate retryable 503 while shared heavy gate is held

limitations: Development smoke is not independent gold relevance evaluation or the Phase 7 release gate
Global dense floor may reject useful matches after corpus changes; lexical matches independently qualify
No filtered ANN/scaling/latency percentile or peak-memory benchmark in Phase 6
CPU producers are non-preemptive; busy search is retryable and does not silently return lexical-only results
No generated answers, image/audio query uploads, caption generation, GPU or external connectors
Tags filter stored metadata; tag editor and general language detection are not implemented
